*one hobby

I seem to have a ton of interests and hobbies, things that I start, but I’m never able to see them to fruition.

For example, I write well and have wanted to write a book for the longest. I also have several started, but never completed. I started a blog, left it after 10 odd articles. Started an Insta channel with an aim of 10k in a year, but am at 3.5k right now and its November and I dont see what I can do to make it grow.. i love it, but im not enjoying it and the lack of growth makes me less and less motivated. I started music production but my neck hurt from sitting the long hours and I figured I have to learn a lot of things even when im good at music.

I enjoy alll of these things but somehow I’m never able to see any of it to be successful enough to mean anything. What should I do??
